name: local-proxy-server
title: In-app local proxy server (HTTP CONNECT + SOCKS5)
description: Add an opt-in loopback HTTP/HTTPS-CONNECT and SOCKS5 proxy server inside Ameow desktop so local browsers, system proxy settings and the browser extension can route outbound traffic through Ameow's existing single-precedence network route (manual > system > environment > direct).
creator: wjingshan
notes: Shipped in 668d9b0. Automated verification is green: npm run type-check, npm run lint, npm run docs:build, plus 30 socket-level cases (src/config/localProxyServer.test.ts, electron/localProxyUpstream.test.mts, electron/localProxyServer.test.mts). Two items still need a GUI machine before the next release smoke test: loading a page in a real browser through the proxy, and a live manual-proxy upstream actually receiving CONNECT traffic.
